changes.tariffModel: No deterministic Smartbit-wide tariff. Smartbit supplies charging hardware and the THOR management/payment platform to independent station managers; THOR explicitly supports manager-specific payment/configuration and Smartbit hardware can also be FREE or RFID-only.

officialEvidence.finding: Smartbit describes THOR as a cloud platform for management of charging stations and identifies its business as charging hardware plus management software.
ANTHEA stations can be FREE, RFID or OCPP/THOR; THOR gives station managers payment management and configuration customization.
SMALL stations likewise support FREE/RFID/OCPP modes and THOR manager-specific payment/configuration controls.
THOR is presented as a management system for charging-station fleets, including user/payment administration, not as a single retail CPO tariff network.

negativeEvidence: No current first-party Smartbit/THOR national network-wide or class-wide EV charging tariff was found.
Smartbit branding or THOR backend presence is insufficient to infer a common direct tariff because the station manager controls payment/configuration and some hardware can operate free or RFID-only.
